name: Dot-matrix and LED display
look: everything is made of round or square lit dots/segments: text scrolling on LED boards, images resolved from amber/red dot grids.

fits.notes: hardware, transit, data, fintech tickers, Nothing-style tech; brand with a physical display

type.guidance: 5x7 dot fonts (DotGothic16, Doto, Nothing's NDot), amber/red/white on black.
type.rule: Style type is for the world's chrome and display; the brand face always sets the real claim line and any product UI text.

colour.guidance: 5x7 dot fonts (DotGothic16, Doto, Nothing's NDot), amber/red/white on black.
colour.rule: Style palette fills the world; the brand colour takes the role named in brand_lock.colour_role and never drops below the contrast of the brand's own palette.

keeps: real product UI capture (composited as a screen plate, never redrawn)
brand_lock.colour_role: lit dot colour is the brand colour (or amber / white when the brand is dark neutral)
brand_lock.type_role: 5x7 dot font for the board; brand face for the claim in a clear frame
brand_lock.world_changes: everything is made of lit dots, scrolling tickers, row wipes
brand_lock.rule: Under a brand lock the brand colour, type and logo stay; the style world (material, picture language, motion grammar, finish, sound) is what varies between looks. A branded launch shows 3 different style worlds.

hints: dot grid shader sampling a source texture (luminance to dot size or brightness)
motion_grammar.note: grammars lists existing library/grammars ids; grammars_planned lists world grammars the engine plan adds (game-world, tabletop, os-desktop, type-only, editorial, collage, cinematic-world).

effects.role: resolve any plate or DOM snapshot into lit dots

effects_note: rasan-fx passes (runtime/rasan-fx.js); order is the pass order. {brand_colour} / {second_ink} are filled from the brand or look palette.

codex_assets.prompt_template: high-contrast portrait / product photo of {subject} on plain black background, to be resolved into dots

animate_with.what: displacement / warp (shader fed by noise or depth)

codex_assets.r1_note: stills (portraits, products) used as the source for dot resolve; A3.
codex_assets.rules: Flat, evenly lit plain background (chroma green or pure white) for clean cut-outs; one prompt family with the same seed words; generate at 2x and downscale; never ask Codex for readable UI text or logos (typeset them in HTML).

build.recipe: canvas 2D or fragment shader: render DOM/video to a low-res texture then draw as dots (radial falloff, additive blend, bloom). Nearest to `dot-system` grammar and `hud` style; needs a "display" runtime.

product_ui_rule: If the film shows RasanAI Studio, use the current dark sidebar UI with the Describe...Final dot stepper (docs/brand/studio-ui/), as a real capture composited INTO this style; never the retired light UI.

brand_lock.rule: LED colour is the brand colour if it is bright enough on black (luma above 40%); otherwise fall back to amber. The board stays black. Slots marked brand take the brand colour (exact hex); slots marked style keep the palette value; brand-or-style takes the brand colour only when its contrast against the other slot is at least 4.5:1, else the palette value.

scale.note: cqw = 1% of the frame width (1080p: 1cqw = 19.2 px)

pairings.note: 5x7 dot fonts; render as LEDs via the ledmatrix pass rather than relying on the glyph.

scale.note: cqw = 1% of the frame width (1080p: 1cqw = 19.2 px)

pairings.note: Doto is a true dot-matrix variable face.

type.load: In a HyperFrames composition add the two <link> tags from `google` to <head> (plus rel=preconnect to fonts.googleapis.com and fonts.gstatic.com), set font-family from `css`, and wait for document.fonts.ready before the first screenshot / timeline build. Offline renders: download the families once (they are OFL) into the project's fonts/ folder and use @font-face. The brand face always sets the real claim line and the product UI text; the style pairing is for the world's chrome and display.
type.rule: Style type is for the world's chrome and display; the brand face always sets the real claim line and any product UI text. Under a brand lock keep the brand face for the claim and use the pairing's display for labels only.

passes.role: the whole frame quantised to LED cells

finish.how: Runtime: RasanFX.create({ source, passes: [...] }) from runtime/rasan-fx.js, applied in the listed order, on the whole composition canvas or on the Codex plate only (plate-only when the type must stay crisp). `css` lists the cheap approximation kinds story boards and style frames draw with plain CSS (grain:<opacity>, scan:<opacity>, halftone, pixel, led-dots ...).

composition.grid: frame as a board of 96x54 LEDs; everything aligned to cells; scrolling marquee lines
composition.safe_area: 8% margin = 4 dead columns of LEDs; text 2-3 lines
composition.fill: the board fills 100%; real housing visible only in rare wide shots
composition.product_ui: UI is converted to a low-res LED render (a 'what the board sees' beat), the true UI appears on a small LCD inset

codex.template: {subject} {action}, {setting}. Camera and lens: straight-on board shot or a 50 mm macro on one LED corner, f/2.8. Lighting: self-lit LEDs, soft glow bloom, black housing. Material: round LED dots on matte black, a faint grid of unlit dots. Colour, locked to the palette {palette_words}, and nothing outside it. Texture and finish: visible unlit dots at 6% brightness, mild bloom. Avoid: no text, no letters, no logos, no watermark, no smooth gradients, no antialiased text, no colours other than the LED palette, no photographic faces.
codex.camera: straight-on board shot or a 50 mm macro on one LED corner, f/2.8
codex.lighting: self-lit LEDs, soft glow bloom, black housing
codex.material: round LED dots on matte black, a faint grid of unlit dots
codex.colour_rule: Name the palette's colours in words (the palette's `words`), never hex codes; add 'and nothing outside this palette'. Pick one palette per film and keep it.
codex.texture: visible unlit dots at 6% brightness, mild bloom
negatives: no colours other than the LED palette

aspect.note: Plates: ask for about 12% bleed around the frame so the camera can travel; keep the calm side empty for type. Generate 16:9 for the frame, 1:1 for sprite sheets and objects.

consistency.anchor: Make the anchor plate first, approve it by eye, then pass it as --ref to every other image (imagegen batch does this with --world).
consistency.style_line: Append the world bible's style line (30-45 words, no hex) to every prompt.
consistency.seed_words: Keep these words verbatim in every prompt of the film: round LED dots on matte black; straight-on board shot or a 50 mm macro on one LED corner; black board, amber LEDs, red-orange.

sprite_sheet.rules: Not a sprite style. For a cut-out object or character use --transparent (flat #00FF00 key, then despill); one subject, no shadow plane.

do: Quantise everything to the same cell grid
Animate with marquee scrolls and row-by-row wipes
dont: No smooth easing: step it on 2s
cheap_ways: A dotted font on a normal screen with no LED pass
Dots too small to read at 1080p
